name: The Sky Residences at W Aspen
positioning: Residences at the base of Aspen Mountain with mountainside slope access, private rooftop decks with hot tubs and 360-degree mountain views, and bold design drawn from Ute patterns and Aspen's silver-mining past
best_for: Skiers and summer adventurers who want to stay at the base of Aspen Mountain
Groups and families who want a residence with a private rooftop deck

facts.text: Year-round activities range from skiing in winter to paragliding, rock climbing and rafting in summer.
The property is moments from high-end shopping, museums, galleries and music venues.
Each residence has an open floor plan with hardwood flooring and a floating vanity in each bathroom.
Guests can book the culinary team for private chef dining in their residence.
Hidalgo is a speakeasy-inspired agave cocktail lounge and tequileria.
The Whatever/Whenever service handles guest requests.
Guest services include taking a spin in a BMW X7 or X5 and overnight ski storage.
Dogs are welcome and get a W-branded pet bed.
The fitness center has Peloton bikes, a TRX system and boxing equipment.
Aspen-Pitkin County Airport is about 4 miles from the hotel.

highlights.text: Residence guests have their own private rooftop deck with a hot tub, fire pit, BBQ grill and 360-degree mountain views, as well as access to the public WET Deck.
The Sky Residences at W Aspen is located at the base of Aspen Mountain, with mountainside access to the slopes and panoramic views.
The residences feature modern takes on Ute Native American patterns, references to silver mining and furniture inspired by the 1970s.
The suspended DJ booth takes its cue from the largest silver nugget discovered in Aspen at the turn of the century.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes the lively W atmosphere may not suit guests seeking a quiet, traditional alpine retreat.
